newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Diesel Q1 shr $0.26, revs $520 mln.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Diesel Q1 shr $0.26, revs $520 mln.

text.p: Detroit Diesel Corp said Tuesday that, based on preliminary results, it posted earnings per share of $0.26 for the first quarter of 1997 on net income of $6.4 million.

Addressing the company's annual meeting, Roger Penske, chairman, said that revenues for the quarter, based on preliminary results, were approximately $520 million, 9.0 percent more than the year-ago level.
For the first quarter of 1996, the company had a net income of $8.3 million, or $0.34 per primary share, on net revenues of $478.0 million.

Penske said the first quarter 1997 results "reflect continued strong unit sales in the company's major market segments." He cited higher on-highway or heavy-duty truck sales and a solid contribution from automotive and light truck sales as the key elements to the company's first quarter.
Selling, general and administrative expenses were higher due to new product introduction and costs related to the unit volume increase, but these were anticipated, he said.
The company said it will release its final results for the first quarter on May 1.
Detroit Diesel makes heavy-duty diesel and alternative fuel engines, automotive diesel engines and related products and offers financing through Detroit Diesel Capital Corp.
